name: @ionic-enterprise/apple-pay
description: Capacitor Plugin used to enable Apple Pay in an Application
author: Ionic Team <hi@ionic.io> (https://ionicframework.com)

scripts.verify: npm run verify:ios && npm run verify:android && npm run verify:web
scripts.verify:android: cd android && ./gradlew clean build test && cd ..
scripts.lint: npm run prettier -- --check && npm run swiftlint -- lint
scripts.fmt: npm run eslint -- --fix && npm run prettier -- --write && npm run swiftlint -- --fix --format
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && rollup -c rollup.config.mjs
scripts.docs: typedoc --plugin typedoc-plugin-markdown --theme ./node_modules/@ionic/markdown-docs-theme/dist src/index.ts && rm -rf website/docs/{enums,interfaces,classes} && mv api/{enums,interfaces,classes} website/docs && mv api/modules.md website/docs/modules.md && rm -rf api
